raw: hello alex I reviewed the proposed changes this morning and I think the recording controls are ready for another test please keep the original transcript available because we still need to compare the punctuation do not change the default mode yet I want to test it on the older laptop first the small model should stay optional and the microphone must remain off while the app is idle please check the cancellation behavior and the clipboard recovery after switching windows once those checks pass we can prepare a new development build and ask the team to try it next week
